narrative.explanation: RON 90,140.24 of related-party and other-debtor receivables is 0.1% of total assets and 0.4% of equity; written off in full, the equity ratio moves from 36.0% to 35.9% and the current ratio from 0.58× to 0.58×. Graded info: the amount at stake is 0.4% of total equity, against the ladder printed beside this finding. Equity is the cushion a lender writes the exposure off against, so the exposure is graded as a share of that cushion rather than of the balance sheet it is already inside.
